shortDescription: Get resource-tcp objects facts on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: domains_to_process
options.description: Indicates which domains to process the commands on. It cannot be used with the details-level full, must be run from the System Domain only and with ignore-warnings true. Valid values are, CURRENT_DOMAIN, ALL_DOMAINS_ON_THIS_SERVER.

options.name: filter
options.description: Search expression to filter objects by. The provided text should be exactly the same as it would be given in SmartConsole Object Explorer. The logical operators in the expression ('AND', 'OR') should be provided in capital letters. The search involves both a IP search and a textual search in name, comment, tags etc.

options.name: limit
options.description: The maximal number of returned results. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name. This parameter is relevant only for getting a specific object.

options.name: offset
options.description: Number of the results to initially skip. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects.

options.name: order
options.description: Sorts the results by search criteria. Automatically sorts the results by Name, in the ascending order. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.
